feature.label: Forms
feature.description: Configurable request and workflow forms with per-form access, submissions and evaluation.

ui.formsFeatureDisabledNotice: The forms feature is currently disabled.
ui.workflowFormsText: Submit structured requests, review incoming submissions and keep access aligned to the right people and groups.
ui.loadingFormsText: Atlas is fetching the forms you can access.
ui.manageFormHint: Can edit structure, access and status. The creator always keeps access.
ui.evaluateFormHint: Can inspect submissions and record review notes or decisions.
ui.viewFormHint: Can open the form without necessarily submitting or reviewing it.
ui.noForms: No forms are available for you yet.
ui.noFormsText: Ask an administrator to grant access to a form or to activate the forms plugin.
ui.noFieldsYet: No fields yet. Add the first field to start building this form.
ui.selectFormText: Create request and workflow forms, define fields, and configure who may view, submit or evaluate each form.
ui.formsDescriptionPlaceholder: Collect access, account or workflow requests.
ui.formsDefaultIntroText: Please complete the required information before submitting.
